name: classroom-stage
description: SocraticNovel classroom stage: a galgame-style stage (B 讲台骨架 ＋ C 書庫材质) mounted on the official `conversation.view` slot — the only session-scoped seat that exposes the conversation stream (useChat/useConversation). Renders the conversation body with design tokens measured from real gameplay screenshots, on a fixed 1920×1080 canvas scaled by JS. Undeployed Live2D assets report an explicit status; every visible control has a real handler.
